ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel base with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters appearing as localized surface features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity distribution across the majority of both lobes. High-contrast white linear and point-cluster mapping is visible, with linear features concentrated on the right lobe and point clusters scattered across the left lobe and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with an interior angle of approximately 75 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:1.5 within its bounding region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular frequency of peaks and valleys along the trailing boundary; high-frequency micro-serrations near the notch transitioning to low-frequency, high-amplitude jagged protrusions toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curvature of the trailing edge originating from the central notch and terminating at upward-oriented, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel clusters on the medial left lobe and dense high-intensity clusters at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally across the right lobe and horizontally across the central left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes and irregular, high-intensity erosion/scarring patterns at the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe tip that breaks the standard serration pattern of the rest of the edge.
